meta.name: dial-cli
meta.description: Reference for the `dial` CLI — gives you a real phone number to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and receive inbound texts/codes via the Dial platform (getdial.ai). Use when the user mentions phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes; when they ask to text, call, ring, or wait for a code from someone; before running any `dial …` command for the first time in a session; or when investigating what the Dial platform can do. Load this skill before invoking the CLI — `dial --help` alone will not surface the workflows, the `--json` conventions, or the docs-lookup pattern needed to use Dial correctly.

copy.tagline: 用命令行发送短信、拨打电话并接收验证码
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果需要在命令行中完成短信和通话
copy.tagline_en: Send SMS, make voice calls, and receive codes from the command line
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a real phone number for texts and calls via CLI

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会用 dial 命令行操作一个真实电话号码：发短信、拨打由 AI 语音代理接听的电话、等待并接收来信与验证码。所有命令都支持 --json 便于解析输出。
howto.when: 当你提到电话、通话、短信、语音、验证码等关键词，或要求发短信、打电话、等验证码时触发；会话中首次运行 dial 命令前也会先加载。

say.note: 会调用 dial message 发出短信

say.text: 拨给 +14155550123，让对方知道我晚点到
等一条短信验证码，收到就告诉我
say.note: 会执行 dial wait-for 等待来信并解析内容

howto.what_en: Claude can use the dial CLI to send SMS, place AI voice calls, and wait for or receive inbound texts and verification codes through a real phone number. Every command supports --json output.
howto.when_en: Use when you mention phones, calls, texts, SMS, voice, OTP, 2FA, or verification codes, or ask to text, call, or wait for a code; also before the first dial command in a session.

say_en.note: Runs dial message to send the SMS

say_en.text: Call +14155550123 and tell them I'll be late
say_en.note: Starts an AI voice call; check it with dial call get

say_en.text: Wait for an SMS verification code and tell me when it arrives
